questions.stem: What is the largest value of f(x) = 4 − x² over all real x?
questions.explain: x² is never negative, so 4 − x² is at most 4. It reaches 4 at x = 0, the top of the downward parabola.
A product is zero only if a factor is zero. eˣ is always positive, so it is never zero. That leaves x + 1 = 0, so x = −1.

questions.stem: For which x in the interval 0 ≤ x ≤ 2π is cos x = 0?
questions.explain: On the unit circle cos x is the x-coordinate, which is 0 at the top (π/2) and the bottom (3π/2).

questions.stem: What is the derivative of x³ − 3x?
questions.explain: The power rule brings the exponent down and lowers it by one: x³ gives 3x², and 3x gives 3.

questions.stem: Which function is continuous at every point of [−1, 1]?
questions.explain: |x| has no gap or jump anywhere. 1/x and x/|x| are undefined at 0, and ⌊x⌋ jumps from −1 to 0 at x = 0.
